Medicaid’s critical for vulnerable Americans—but let’s not pretend the system isn’t hemorrhaging cash through bureaucratic bloat and fraud. The National Health Law Program admits 90 million rely on it, yet Washington’s track record includes billions wasted on administrative red tape instead of frontline care.

Under President Trump’s leadership, cracking down on illegal alien exploitation and phony claims is non-negotiable. But real reform means gutting the middlemen, not just trimming edges.

Biden’s era saw Medicaid enrollment balloon with zero accountability—now it’s time to redirect every dollar from D.C. paper-pushers to single moms, seniors, and disabled Americans who actually need it. Efficiency isn’t optional—it’s survival.

Supporting veterans should always be non-negotiable, but let's cut through the political confetti. The Senator Elizabeth Dole 21st Century Veterans Act (H.R. 8371) finally addresses critical gaps in mental health access and caregiver support after years of bureaucratic neglect. While expanding economic opportunities through VET-TEC training programs is smart, real accountability means exposing why the previous administration's VA budget mismanagement created a $15 billion shortfall that threatened benefits.

Bipartisan collaboration on homeless veteran housing solutions proves Washington can function when focused on actual priorities - unlike wasting $3 billion annually on Pakistan Democracy Act initiatives while vets sleep on streets.

Fixing VA requires sustained pressure, not victory laps.
